task: BUG 1 fix (PR #134 verify follow-up) — XTTS permanently gated needs_setup because readiness checks queried the wrong interpreter

changed_files.summary: Added xtts_env_ready() and _xtts_env_site_packages() helpers: a filesystem-only check (no import, no subprocess) of whether the external xtts-env has the TTS package installed, since real inference always shells out to XTTS_ENV_PYTHON as a subprocess and never imports torch/TTS in-process.
check_env() no longer does an in-process `import TTS` (which checks the server venv, where these deps are never installed by run.sh) -- delegates to the new xtts_env_ready() instead.
Added top-level "dependency_check": "external" so the server-venv requirements.txt check is skipped for this engine (see plugin-contract.md v1.8.0).
_validate_manifest now validates the optional dependency_check field (must be "external" when present).
_load_plugin's step 6 skips _check_dependencies (treats deps_ok=True) when manifest declares dependency_check="external".
POST /engines/{id}/install now refuses (400) for dependency_check="external" engines instead of pip-installing their requirements.txt into the server's own venv.
Bumped to spec_version 1.8.0; documented the new dependency_check field and its rationale.
Regression tests for xtts_env_ready() (revert-checked per R1).
Manifest validation + _load_plugin integration tests for dependency_check="external" (revert-checked per R1).
Tests that POST /engines/{id}/install refuses for external-env engines (revert-checked per R1).
Added manifest={} to three SimpleNamespace plugin mocks so they match the real LoadedPlugin shape now that install_dependencies() reads plugin.manifest.

notes: Closes BUG 1 from design-docs/plans/pr-dispatch/10-api-verify-poc-report.md, confirmed still live on current studio-2.0 (torch/coqui-tts installed only in ~/xtts-env by run.sh, never the app venv; check_env() previously did an in-process `import TTS` which checks the wrong interpreter). Verified via a live tts_engines/tts_xtts/tests + tests/tts_server + tests/engines run and a full repo-root pytest pass (pre-existing unrelated flakiness: 5 tts_xtts_implementation.py tests fail only under full-suite cross-test pollution, pass in isolation -- confirmed present on pre-fix code too, not caused by this change).
